scripts.import: npm run amelia import && bash scripts/download-addons.sh && echo "finish apply"
scripts.init: npm run download && npm run import && npm run bootstrap
scripts.package: python3 scripts/prepare_l10n.py && bash scripts/download-tor.sh && amelia package
scripts.build:win-x64: cross-env AMELIA_PLATFORM=win32 AMELIA_COMPAT=x86_64 SURFER_COMPAT=x86_64 MIDORI_CROSS_COMPILING=true amelia build
scripts.build:win-arm64: cross-env AMELIA_PLATFORM=win32 AMELIA_COMPAT=aarch64 SURFER_COMPAT=aarch64 MIDORI_CROSS_COMPILING=true amelia build
scripts.build:mac-x64: cross-env AMELIA_PLATFORM=darwin AMELIA_COMPAT=x86_64 SURFER_COMPAT=x86_64 amelia build
scripts.build:mac-arm64: cross-env AMELIA_PLATFORM=darwin AMELIA_COMPAT=aarch64 SURFER_COMPAT=aarch64 amelia build
scripts.build:linux-x64: cross-env AMELIA_PLATFORM=linux AMELIA_COMPAT=x86_64 SURFER_COMPAT=x86_64 amelia build
scripts.build:linux-arm64: cross-env AMELIA_PLATFORM=linux AMELIA_COMPAT=aarch64 SURFER_COMPAT=aarch64 amelia build

scripts.package:win-arm64: python3 scripts/prepare_l10n.py && AMELIA_PLATFORM=win32 AMELIA_COMPAT=aarch64 bash scripts/download-tor.sh && cross-env AMELIA_PLATFORM=win32 AMELIA_COMPAT=aarch64 SURFER_COMPAT=aarch64 MIDORI_CROSS_COMPILING=true amelia package && bash scripts/win-installer.sh aarch64

scripts.package:mac-arm64: python3 scripts/prepare_l10n.py && AMELIA_PLATFORM=darwin AMELIA_COMPAT=aarch64 bash scripts/download-tor.sh && cross-env AMELIA_PLATFORM=darwin AMELIA_COMPAT=aarch64 SURFER_COMPAT=aarch64 amelia package
scripts.package:linux-x64: python3 scripts/prepare_l10n.py && AMELIA_PLATFORM=linux AMELIA_COMPAT=x86_64 bash scripts/download-tor.sh && cross-env AMELIA_PLATFORM=linux AMELIA_COMPAT=x86_64 SURFER_COMPAT=x86_64 amelia package
scripts.package:linux-arm64: python3 scripts/prepare_l10n.py && AMELIA_PLATFORM=linux AMELIA_COMPAT=aarch64 bash scripts/download-tor.sh && cross-env AMELIA_PLATFORM=linux AMELIA_COMPAT=aarch64 SURFER_COMPAT=aarch64 amelia package
scripts.bootstrap:win: bash scripts/prepare-bootstrap-repo.sh && cross-env AMELIA_PLATFORM=win32 MIDORI_CROSS_COMPILING=true amelia bootstrap
scripts.bootstrap:mac: bash scripts/prepare-bootstrap-repo.sh && cross-env AMELIA_PLATFORM=darwin amelia bootstrap
